findings.title: APT29 Watering Holes Target Unpatched iPhones and Android Devices
findings.summary_md: APT29 compromised the Ukrainian analytics tracker Plerdy to serve n-day exploits to mobile users via watering holes hosted on legitimate websites. The campaign targeted unpatched iPhones and Android devices using already disclosed and patched flaws. Infosecurity Magazine framed it as an APT29 mobile exploitation campaign.

findings.title: Russian hackers target iOS and Android users with n-day exploits
findings.summary_md: Russia's APT29 used compromised websites and a hijacked Ukrainian analytics tracker to hit unpatched mobile devices with n-day exploits. The operation targeted both iOS and Android users through watering-hole sites.

findings.title: Poisoned Source: APT29 Watering Holes Targets Mobile Devices
findings.summary_md: Sekoia TDR investigated a large-scale APT29 watering-hole campaign targeting iOS and Android users through compromised websites, fake domains, and a compromised analytics supply chain. The campaign served n-day exploit chains to unpatched mobile devices to steal sensitive mobile data.

findings.title: Russian APT29 Targets Mobile Users with Watering Hole Attacks
findings.summary_md: Russia-linked group APT29 targeted iOS and Android users through hijacked websites and a compromised analytics service. The campaign delivered mobile watering-hole attacks via legitimate sites.
